description: This file contains Redux action creators and constants for managing explore-related state in the Superset frontend, including fetching data sources, updating form controls, toggling favorites, and managing chart slices.

methods.name: updateFormDataByDatasource
methods.description: Creates an action to update form data based on datasource changes.

methods.name: fetchDatasourceSucceeded
methods.description: Creates an action indicating successful fetch of a datasource.

methods.name: fetchDatasourcesStarted
methods.description: Creates an action indicating the start of fetching multiple datasources.

methods.name: fetchDatasourcesSucceeded
methods.description: Creates an action indicating successful fetch of multiple datasources.

methods.name: toggleFaveStar
methods.description: Creates an action to toggle the favorite star status.

methods.name: fetchFaveStar
methods.description: Fetches favorite status for a chart slice and dispatches toggleFaveStar.

methods.name: saveFaveStar
methods.description: Saves the favorite status for a chart slice and handles errors.

methods.name: setControlValue
methods.description: Creates an action to set a control's value and validation errors.

methods.name: setExploreControls
methods.description: Creates an action to update explore controls with form data.

methods.name: setFormData
methods.description: Creates an action to set the entire form data.

methods.name: updateChartTitle
methods.description: Creates an action to update the chart's title.

methods.name: setSaveAction
methods.description: Creates an action to set the save action type.

methods.name: createNewSlice
methods.description: Creates an action to add a new chart slice with permissions and form data.

methods.name: sliceUpdated
methods.description: Creates an action indicating a slice has been updated.

methods.name: setForceQuery
methods.description: Creates an action to set the force query flag.

methods.name: setStashFormData
methods.description: Creates an action to stash form data visibility and fields.

methods.name: startMetaDataLoading
methods.description: Creates an action to indicate metadata loading has started.

methods.name: stopMetaDataLoading
methods.description: Creates an action to indicate metadata loading has stopped.

methods.name: syncDatasourceMetadata
methods.description: Creates an action to synchronize datasource metadata.
